hooks.text: Your chatbot answers. Why can't it act?
hooks.explanation: Question formula: states what the viewer already knows (the chatbot answers), then opens the gap the video closes (why it can't act); says 'your' first, inside the 3-second hook window.

hooks.text: Before you build, know agent versus chatbot.
hooks.explanation: Warning formula: ties the distinction to the viewer's next project, which is why this audience cares; no open question, so less pull.

hooks.text: Chatbot or agent: which one runs tasks?
hooks.explanation: Question formula framed as a choice; clear and on topic, but it names no stakes for the viewer, so it pulls less than a direct 'your' question.

hooks.text: Stop calling your chatbot an AI agent.
hooks.explanation: Mistake formula: corrects a mix-up head-on; risks sounding preachy to beginners and promises a correction rather than a payoff.

hooks.text: Your chatbot answers. An agent acts.
hooks.explanation: The clearest six-word contrast, but it answers itself, so there is no gap left to close; best reused as the takeaway line.
